messages:
sam: Quick UX check-in: proposing a slim drawer (slides from right) for 'Create credential' instead of a full modal or inline row. Keeps list visible but gives space for scope presets. Mock: https://staging.redwood.local/mock/creds-slimdrawer-2245678901.png

maria: Slim drawer could be a good middle ground. My main ask: show a short risk hint near the scope presets so non-admins don't pick broad scopes by accident. Maybe a tiny badge 'recommended' on safe presets. :bulb:

taylor: Love the badge idea. Also suggest a tiny 'why this?' tooltip linking to docs for each preset, that opens in a new tab. Less cognitive load inline.

lee: Engineering notes: drawer is fine. Important: do not load full org-scope matrix until the user opens the 'Advanced scopes' section in the drawer. We'll lazy-load recommended presets and metadata on drawer open, but defer heavy lists. Also keep keyboard focus inside drawer while open and restore focus to the Create button on close.

ada: A11y points: drawer must have role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" with an accessible label. For the preset badges, use aria-describedby pointing to helper text. If a scope preset is selected, announce "Preset selected: read-only" via a polite live region.

maria: Copy option for the small risk hint: A) 'Recommended: read-only for getting started' B) 'Safer default: read-only' I prefer A, slightly more action-oriented.

sam: Also experimenting with a new revoke interaction: slide the row left to archive (like swipe) showing inline actions 'Restore' and 'Delete now'. For desktop, a small chevron reveals the actions. This avoids a blocking modal. Thoughts?

taylor: Swipe/slide is friendly on touch, but we must ensure keyboard users can access the same actions. Maybe an overflow menu with 'Archive' so keyboard users get parity.

lee: Backend contract for archive: POST /credentials/{id}/archive returns job_id; restore is POST /credentials/{id}/restore. Both operations must be idempotent. UI should show 'Archiving...' then an amber inline banner 'Archived  Restore | Delete' that times out into the archived shelf after 8s. Also include an audit_id in the response for linking to event logs.

ada: Accessibility: when the amber inline banner appears, announce once with role="status" and aria-live="polite": 'Credential archived. Restore available for 7 days.' If the user activates Restore, update role="status" aria-live="assertive" with 'Credential restored.' Make sure the inline Restore button is keyboard-tabbable before the banner auto-dismisses.

maria: Microcopy tweak for the archived banner: prefer 'Credential archived  Restore' over 'Archived  Delete permanently' — softer helps reduce panic. Also suggest the shelf header reads 'Archived credentials (7 days)'.

sam: One more: secret reveal mechanics. Proposal: reveal returns a one-time token (10s TTL), shows the value, then masks automatically. Show a small audit pill 'Viewed by <user>' in the row while visible. We should rate-limit reveals and surface an error if over quota.

lee: We'll implement reveal as GET /credentials/{id}/reveal -> {value, ttl, audit_id}. Rate-limit 5 reveals/min per actor. If limit hit, return 429.REVEAL_RATE_LIMIT. UI should show friendly error: 'Too many reveal attempts. Try again in a minute.'

ada: For SR users: when the secret is revealed, put the value into an aria-live polite region and also add aria-describedby on the row pointing to 'Secret revealed for 10 seconds'. Ensure the reveal button has aria-pressed state while visible. After auto-mask, announce 'Secret hidden' once.

taylor: Small UX ask: show environment chip near each credential (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with a tooltip explaining behavioral differences. Keep chip subtle but accessible.

maria: Contrast nit: current chip color is low contrast on light backgrounds. We need >=4.5:1 for body text. Try darker border + transparent fill or navy text on pale background.

lee: Agreed. We'll standardize chip styles and include 'env_hint' in the list API so UI can render consistently. If tapping the chip opens details, make it a real button with aria-haspopup and a clear label.

ada: Accessibility checklist to add to the ticket: drawer role/labeling, focus trap + restore, combobox/preset keyboard support, aria-live announcements for archive/reveal, visible focus rings for chips and banner buttons, reveal rate-limit error text programmatically associated with the control. I'll attach code examples.

sam: Action items: (1) I'll update mocks with 'recommended' badges, drawer copy A, and the archived banner flow. (2) @lee add job_id + audit_id fields and rate-limit error codes to the API spec. (3) @ada add the a11y acceptance criteria and snippets. (4) @maria finalize microcopy and chip color suggestions.

deploy-bot: sam opened branch feat/creds-slimdrawer-2245678901  CI: green, preview: https://staging.redwood.local/preview/creds-slimdrawer-2245678901

maria: I'll draft a brief UX doc with visuals and a short checklist for QA. If the drawer A/B looks good, we can ramp to more traffic next sprint.

sam: Thanks team  I'll post a 1-minute Loom demonstrating keyboard flow + swipe gesture tomorrow.
